messages.author: 035d95299e14c533
messages.subject: Genetic map
parts:
Hi Karl,

I could not plot a nice genetic map with marker names.
The function show.marker.names plotted the marker names on top of each other. So, nothing is viable.

Is there a way to deal with this problem?


Thanks 

Kanat

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Genetic map
parts:
Not with R/qtl.

You can plot an interactive map with R/qtlcharts (https://kbroman.org/qtlcharts); shows the marker name when you hover, or highlights a marker after you search for it.

Or consider the LinkageMapView package, https://cran.r-project.org/package=LinkageMapView

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Genetic map
parts:

How should one treat the map data of RILs to estimate recombination frequency ?
If it is read as 'riself' in read.cross all the heterzygotes are omitted from the analysis.
Should i read it as F2? 

Kanat
